stages.name: Old Well
stages.description: He threw a question into the ancient, bottomless well, and received an answer in return.

stages.name: Center Plaza
stages.description: "A Sea Terror in the Plaza." Sounds a bit like an Iberian proverb.

stages.name: Seaside Path
stages.description: He grew up along the coast. He longed for the freedom to see the ocean.

stages.name: Plaza South
stages.description: Did they turn to worship the sea because they despaired for the land?

stages.name: Penal Battalion Forward Base
stages.description: Here, and there too! They're everywhere!

stages.name: Empty Street
stages.description: Along the uninhabited street, travelers from afar now sing.

stages.name: Quiet Trail
stages.description: They walk here freely.

stages.name: Seaside Street
stages.description: On the long road beside the ocean, the representatives of two civilizations speak herein.

stages.name: Landing Point
stages.description: It shuts its eyes, its sweet dreams unperturbed for over a decade.

stages.name: Lighthouse Entrance
stages.description: Before you step through the entrance, you must first sweep aside all obstacles. < Hand of the Saint > Bounces a "Hand of the Saint" in the deployed direction, stunning and dealing damage to enemies it collides with.

stages.name: Lighthouse Control Room
stages.description: Lay foes low with bravery's blade. Light the way with hope's flame. < Hand of the Saint > Bounces a "Hand of the Saint" in the deployed direction, stunning and dealing damage to enemies it collides with.

stages.name: Central Passage
stages.description: Within the broken mirror, Specter finally sees her completed self . < Hand of the Saint > Bounces a "Hand of the Saint" in the deployed direction, stunning and dealing damage to enemies it collides with.

stages.name: Lower Hall
stages.description: His eyes widened with anger, his hand not letting go of the helm for decades.

stages.name: Ballroom
stages.description: Come as you please, leave in pieces. Freely does wine pour, bodies litter the floor.

stages.name: Golden Corridor
stages.description: He distinguishes not between the beautiful and the ugly. He knows no fear, and understands no fatigue–What shall we make of such a person? < Hand of the Saint > Bounces a "Hand of the Saint" in the deployed direction, stunning and dealing damage to enemies it collides with.

stages.name: Command Hall
stages.description: There is no road ahead, as far as the eyes can see.

stages.name: Main Bridge
stages.description: The Seaborn never see their own as enemies. This is a behavior unique to humans.

stages.name: Observation Post
stages.description: It does not fit in with its surroundings. < Hand of the Saint > Bounces a "Hand of the Saint" in the deployed direction, stunning and dealing damage to enemies it collides with.

stages.name: Deck Room
stages.description: The unbearable past relentlessly chases him. The unfaceable future solemnly awaits him.

stages.name: Main Mast
stages.description: How should one sort out one's thoughts, when reuniting with a mortal enemy after a long absence? Share a dance.

stages.name: Signal Light Array
stages.description: Past and future alike are torn asunder here. < Hand of the Saint > Bounces a "Hand of the Saint" in the deployed direction, stunning and dealing damage to enemies it collides with.

stages.name: Ceremonial Plaza
stages.description: It stands before you. You may not be its kin, but you are both creations of nature. < Hand of the Saint > Bounces a "Hand of the Saint" in the deployed direction, stunning and dealing damage to enemies it collides with.

stages.name: Gran Faro
stages.description: Pack your bags, and return to the starting point. The road ahead is still long.

stages.name: First Landfall
stages.description: From the bottom of the sea they come, bearing gifts.

stages.name: Wilderness Journey
stages.description: How does one hide the trails left by visitors from afar? < Hand of the Saint > Bounces a "Hand of the Saint" in the deployed direction, stunning and dealing damage to enemies it collides with. Tiles do not have melee/ranged restrictions.

stages.name: Proxy
stages.description: They require someone to guide their way, as the road ahead is long.

stages.name: Grand Palace
stages.description: Countless rivers will converge here, bringing along with them silt and memories. It is inevitable. < Hand of the Saint > Bounces a "Hand of the Saint" in the deployed direction, stunning and dealing damage to enemies it collides with.

stages.name: Ship of Fools
stages.description: Those who are out of sight are not out of mind, for a reunion is imminent. < Hand of the Saint > Bounces a "Hand of the Saint" in the deployed direction, stunning and dealing damage to enemies it collides with.

stages.name: Far-Seeing Lighthouse
stages.description: Defending this small island surrounded by hope and loneliness, embrace the ocean. < Hand of the Saint > Bounces a "Hand of the Saint" in the deployed direction, stunning and dealing damage to enemies it collides with.

stages.name: Engulfing Waves
stages.description: Countless waves swell in front of you, the lights of countless homes flicker behind you. Retreat is not an option. < Hand of the Saint > Bounces a "Hand of the Saint" in the deployed direction, stunning and dealing damage to enemies it collides with.

stages.name: Fragments of Silence
stages.description: In order to survive, humans reshape nature, and the Seaborn reshape themselves. < Hand of the Saint > Bounces a "Hand of the Saint" in the deployed direction, stunning and dealing damage to enemies it collides with.

stages.name: Plots Unperturbed
stages.description: The reasons why plots concealed in the dark fail are often not known until after the fact. Condition: Nourished Spewers have increased ASPD and Invisibility .

stages.name: Ambitions Unrewarded
stages.description: Unfulfilled desires always shine brightly in the mind's eye, but that cannot be avoided, only confronted. Condition: Nourished Swarmcallers have increased DEF.

stages.name: Paths Untrodden
stages.description: Grieve not for the lost. Condition: Nourished Predators have increased movement speed.

stages.name: Persons Unseen
stages.description: For we are displaced. Condition: Nourished Reefbreakers have increased ASPD.

stages.name: Duties Unfinished
stages.description: What you let down, you cannot get back. Condition: Nourished Reefbreakers and Spewers have increased ASPD and Attack Range.

stages.name: Hatred Unabated
stages.description: But letting yourself down deserves forgiveness. Condition: Enemies have increased HP and ATK.

stages.name: Dreams Untouched
stages.description: He closes his eyes, and sees a serene sea.

stages.name: Wishes Unfulfilled
stages.description: With a sigh, let despair spread.

stages.name: One's Death
stages.description: Fame, responsibility, ideals. Everything ends here.
